packages.label: יִרְאָה וְיָרֵא שַׁבָּת
packages.label_en: Fear of God and Shabbat Awe
packages.reason: ירא שבת is explicitly called a bechina of יראה (complete fear of God). They share the same essential nature: awe of the Divine. ירא שבת is not a different quality from yirah — it is yirah in its complete form, when da'at is whole and kesilut has been removed by Shabbat freedom. One is the general principle, the other is its full expression on Shabbat.
